create_optimizer_sgd: create an SGD optimizer from training hyperparameters and a PyTorch model
create_optimizer_adam: create an Adam optimizer from training hyperparameters and a PyTorch model
get_optimizer: get a PyTorch optimizer based on the optimizer name in training hyperparameters
create_lr_schedule: create a LambdaLR learning rate schedule with milestone-based decay and warmup
get_lr_schedule: get a learning rate scheduler with gamma decay at milestones and linear warmup
